The scientific-name search returned spectral-sensitivity work on other animals (a Journal of General Physiology paper, volume 55 page 787, whose title is cut off at "The Spectral Sensitivities of Single Receptor" and shows no animal, in two copies plus an untitled PMC page; butterfly long-wavelength opsin tuning; Drosophila photoreceptors; a patent), the Wikipedia list of Polydrusus species, and two Springer links known only by file name (s00359-025-01776-z and BF00194895).
